scope: 16 entries from user's IELTS reading review catalog; materials classified as practice/exam within repository, not independently Cambridge-authenticated

methodology.tokens: Case-insensitive lexical/inflectional matches in archived reading texts (not supporting example sentences); counts per distinct passage; ambiguous word senses are not verified by surface count
methodology.paraphrases: Only explicitly recorded question–passage or study correspondence pairs; counted per manually curated pair, not inferred semantic synonyms; avoid treating paraphrase evidence as official corpus frequency
methodology.rating: To be calibrated with documented overrides and data, preserve baseline for weak evidence
